For a while, I wanted to be a news writer. I changed course after publishing just two articles in *The African Dream*.

### [KNUST Mastercard Foundation Beneficiary Gives Back to His Community](https://www.theafricandream.net/mastercard-beneficiary-gives-back/)

A story about a scholarship beneficiary who donated school uniforms and supplies to pupils in Ghana's Sissala West District.

### [“The 499” Legal battle of the Attorney General and Parliament of Ghana](https://www.theafricandream.net/%E2%80%8Bthe-499-legal-battle-of-ghana/)

An article on the dispute over the admission of 499 qualified applicants to the Ghana School of Law.
